name: HOC Request Automation

lanes.name: Revision
flow: Notify Revision → POST /api/integrations/telegram/notify text طلب تعديل

lanes.name: Delivery
flow: Notify Delivery → POST /api/integrations/telegram/notify text التسليم جاهز

lanes.name: Completed
flow: Notify Completed → POST /api/integrations/telegram/notify text اكتمل المشروع

lanes.name: Other
flow: Forward Event → POST /api/webhooks/n8n with the original event, including QUOTATION_READY which Laravel rejects

normalize.secretHeader: X-N8N-Secret forwarded from the incoming Laravel request

laravelNote: Quotations are not created here. ApplyN8nCallback rejects QUOTATION_READY. ClickUp tasks are created by Laravel.
